topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative opening and outlines the core learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Discovery of oncogenes through tumor viruses and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the historical study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for detecting cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional classification of cancer genes and mutation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the definitions and cellular effects of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes, illustrated through cell cycle regulation and dominant negative mutations.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genomic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the causes of sequence and chromosomal instability arising from defective DNA repair pathways and replication or mitotic errors.

topics.label: Multistep tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sequential somatic mutations drive cancer development and how inherited mutations predispose individuals to malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks, recommended reading, and a look ahead to the next session.
